title: Quarterly Planning - 13 October 2026
summary: The team reviewed hiring progress, approved a $500 referral bonus, and prioritized the Q4 roadmap. They decided to ship the reporting dashboard first, start the mobile redesign in November, and postpone the API v2 migration to next year. Vendor contract renewal will be decided after reviewing alternative quotes, with a fallback to renew if alternatives are not better. Action items were assigned for job description updates, interview scheduling, bonus announcement, roadmap updates, customer notifications, and vendor quote collection.
discussion_points: Two open backend roles; pipeline thin
Six candidates interviewed for first role, none for second; second job description outdated
Referral bonus of $500 per successful hire approved
Q4 roadmap includes mobile redesign, reporting dashboard, and API v2 migration; cannot do all three
API migration risky because two customers still depend on v1
Dashboard chosen to ship first; API v2 migration postponed to next year; mobile redesign scheduled to start in November
Two v1 customers will be notified of the delay
Vendor contract renews on 1 December with decision deadline 15 November
Mobile team’s capacity for November remains an open question
Need to compare alternative vendor quotes before renewal decision
decisions: Referral bonus of $500 per successful hire approved
API v2 migration postponed to next year
Mobile redesign will start in November
Vendor contract renewal decision will be made after comparing alternatives
If alternatives are not better, renewal will proceed
